bio.text: Joey L. Carr is serving his second term in the Arkansas House, representing District 34, which includes a portion of Mississippi County.
He is an elementary principal with the Armorel School District.
He earned a bachelor's degree in education from the University of Central Arkansas and a master's degree in education from Arkansas State University.
